Anya: FYI noticed steady VRAM growth during longctx runs with PagedAttention after the recent kernel-selector change. +4-8GB over ~30k tokens on H100, but not reproducible on our local RTX test.
Matt: can you paste the trace / edges? repro script? :eyes:
Anya: quick repro attached below (small loop, 64k tokens in streaming). saw growth only when pt-coalesce=on + tiling=auto.
Anya: ```bash
# repro loop (container h100-prod-image)
python tests/longctx_repro.py --model paged-attn --seq 65536 --batch 1 --iters 20
date && nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv -l 2 &
```
Sophia: I grabbed a perf trace from the run; kv-pagetable walk dominates and we see many tiny allocations during evict. Snip:
Sophia: ```
[profile] kv_alloc_count: 1243
[profile] pagewalks/sec: 1800
[hot] kernel: pt_walk_coalesce (selected)
[hot] avg latency: 1.2ms (per walk)
```
Rohit: hmm kernel-selector picked the coalescing walk path after the selector refactor (commit 3f9a2b4). That path optimizes for short contexts but allocates metadata per stripe which may leak when stripe fragmentation >> reuse.
Anya: interestingly the Mi250 CI run shows a different pattern: much fewer small allocations but occasional long stalls. H100 shows steady growth, Mi250 shows spikes.
Matt: do we have a heap trace? can we diff before/after selector change?
Sophia: uploaded a mini heap dump + kernel timeline to S3: s3://redwood-debug/2765432109/ (private). Key points: coalesce path creates ~128B meta entries and we don't always collapse adjacent freed entries due to a race in remap.
Rohit: @Anya can you try forcing kernel=pt_walk_default (no coalesce) and confirm? should be a quick flag.
Anya: tried that — memory stabilizes, no growth over same run. So coalesce path is suspicious.
infra-bot: deploy log: selector-refactor rolled to prod on 2025-11-03T03:12Z by ci-bot (3f9a2b4) :white_check_mark:
Matt: actionable next steps: 1) bisect to exact change (Rohit), 2) add sanitizers / assert in pt metadata free path (Sophia), 3) temporary rollback or runtime opt-out for coalesce (Anya).
Rohit: starting bisect now, I have a local repro on h100 staging, will post commit range soon.
Sophia: I'll add extra telemetry to count meta fragments and a periodic consolidation job toggle for tests. if we can reproduce repeatedly we can write a unit that asserts no growth beyond threshold.
Anya: minimal mitigation for prod: expose runtime flag `REDWOOD_KV_PT_COALESCE=0` in dedicated pools and Canary those nodes. Canary should show memory curve flatten.
Matt: also double-check kernel selection metrics — selecting coalesce because of lower mean latency at short seq may be a bad heuristic for tail longctx. Might add sequence-length-aware policy.
Rohit: bisect result: 3f9a2b4 changed the stripe handling and introduced a fast path that skips merge on free for performance. suspect skip is the cause. reverting that one line stops growth.
Sophia: pushed a quick patch to re-enable merge-on-free for the coalesce path in a branch: refs/heads/fix/pt-coalesce-merge. Running longctx loop now.
Anya: current run shows stable memory over 40k tokens with the branch. Thanks. :relieved:
Matt: ok let's plan: PR with test+telemetry, runtime opt-out documented, and rollback if we see any canary regressions. Assign reviewers: @Rohit @Sophia.
Rohit: I'll open the PR and include perf numbers (latency delta ~+0.4% p50, memory stable).
Sophia: filing follow-up ticket to review kernel-selector heuristics and add seq-length bucket to selection.
Anya: tl;dr: coalesce kernel had a merge-on-free skip causing fragment accumulation for long-context PagedAttention on H100. Repro & patch verified. Rolling mitigation via runtime flag while PR lands.
Matt: awesome. add the reproduce script to the issue and mark high-priority for eng-runtime oncall.
Anya: added steps + s3 artifacts to the issue. thanks all.
